newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND PLAYERS FINED FOR CRITICISING TEAM DOCTOR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND PLAYERS FINED FOR CRITICISING TEAM DOCTOR.

text.p: German champions Borussia Dortmund have fined internationals Matthias Sammer and Rene Schneider for criticising the team's doctor in public.
"We won't tolerate players making public comments about Borussia Dortmund employees," coach Ottmar Hitzfeld said on Sunday. He declined to say how much the players had been fined.
Team doctor Achim Buescher quit on Friday after Schneider complained in a soccer magazine that a "blind person" could have diagnosed that he had damaged an ankle ligament rather than a joint capsule.
Schneider turned to national team doctor Hans-Wilhelm Mueller-Wohlfahrt who diagnosed a ligament problem.
